results.title: Simpson Manufacturing Co., Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2025
results.snippet: Simpson describes itself as a leading manufacturer of structural solutions, sold through Simpson Strong-Tie Company Inc. Its wood products include connectors, fasteners, shear-wall systems, and mass timber solutions, while its concrete products include anchors, fiber-reinforced products for protecting and strengthening structures, and fixing solutions for commercial building-envelope applications.

results.title: Simpson Manufacturing Co., Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2023
results.snippet: The filing frames the company as a leading manufacturer of structural solutions for wood, concrete, and steel connections. Its concrete line covers adhesives, chemicals, mechanical anchors, carbide drill bits, powder actuated tools, fiber reinforced materials, and other repair products.

results.title: Simpson Manufacturing Co., Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2022
results.snippet: The language was simpler, calling Simpson a leading manufacturer of high quality wood and concrete construction products.
